dogecoin.text:
I also believe we’re about to witness the greatest memecoin cycle ever. Now, imagine realizing that OSCAR was the first Shiba meme on the internet—the very meme that inspired Kabosu, which led to the creation of the world’s first memecoin, @Dogecoin.

Moreover, OSCAR was the meme https://t.co/X8EBYHtWO1

Imagine thinking that the first Shiba meme on the internet, which inspired Kabosu itself (Shiba meme, Comic Sans, moon) and later gave life to #Dogecoin, is valued at just 3 million in market cap... $OSCAR is the true hidden gold of this market, the precursor of it all!
Coincidence or too big to be true, people forget that OSCAR is the first shiba meme in history and it was the inspiration of the kabosu meme that gave rise to dogecoin!😘
